name: TypeSifter for Elementor
author: joshmishell

sections.description:
TypeSifter for Elementor adds Category and Language filters to the Family field in Elementor’s classic typography popover. Narrow Google Fonts before you pick — without changing Size, Weight, or the rest of the panel.

TypeSifter for Elementor is an independent add-on. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Elementor Ltd. “Elementor” is a trademark of Elementor Ltd.

Tested with Elementor 4.2.0 and Elementor Pro 4.2.0.

What it does

  • Filter Google Fonts by category (Sans Serif, Serif, Display, Handwriting, Monospace)
  • Filter by language / writing system (Latin, Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese, and more)
  • Keep System, Custom, and Adobe/Typekit fonts visible while filters are active
  • Soft-fail safely if Elementor’s editor markup changes — Family still works

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8+
  • Elementor (free). Targets the classic/legacy editor typography popover.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate TypeSifter for Elementor
  3. Edit a page with Elementor, open Typography → Family, and use the filters underneath
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor’s newer Atomic / V4 editor?

Not yet. v1 targets the classic typography popover only.

Does it call Google or any remote API on my site?

No. Font metadata ships with the plugin as a static file.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Renamed to TypeSifter for Elementor.
  • Added Requires Plugins header for the Elementor dependency.
  • Font metadata now loads as a cacheable static file instead of inline script data.
  • Raised minimum WordPress version to 6.8.

1.0.2

  • Language filter uses primaryScript so incidental Latin subsets (e.g. Harmattan) no longer match Latin.

1.0.1

  • Fix Language dropdown stacking under Size responsive device icons.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
